name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?
description: Acrylic alkyd hybrid paints, lacquers, or specialty cabinet enamels are best for kitchen cabinets due to their durability and resistance to wear.

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinets, durable and hard-wearing paints are essential due to the high-traffic nature of kitchens. Acrylic alkyd hybrid paints, often water-based, are highly recommended. They offer the easy cleanup of latex with the hardness and durability of oil-based paints, resisting chips and scratches effectively. Additionally, lacquers or specialty cabinet and trim enamels are excellent choices for a smooth, factory-like finish. Always choose a product designed to withstand frequent cleaning and daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic alkyd hybrid paints, lacquers, or specialty cabinet enamels are best for kitchen cabinets due to their durability and resistance to wear.
